Limited Edition Cheesecake Trifle
By: Corrinne
Published: Monday, December 20, 2010 - 8:00am

Ingredients




1 package Alouette All Natural Limited Edition Cheesecake flavor soft cheese
1 cup of crisp chocolate cookies or vanilla cookies
1 ea. can of prepared sweetened whipped cream for garnishing

Preparation

1 Place cookies in a plastic bag and break into large pieces 2 Begin filling a glass trifle dish or sundae dish alternating layers of of the Cheesecake and broken cookie pieces 3 Top with prepared sweetened whipped cream 4 Garnish with a chocolate cigarette or cookie 5 Variations: 6 Substitute vanilla cookies and vanilla cigarette cookies 7 Alternate layers with the addition of fresh berries
